posts.title: Moving Immich to the NAS — and the Drive That Tried to Take My Photos With It
posts.excerpt: A simple storage migration turned into a genuine scare when the external SSD holding my entire photo library dropped offline mid-copy and the filesystem went into emergency shutdown. SMART was clean though — it was the USB connection all along. One cable swap later: a clean 107 MB/s copy, verified file-for-file, and Immich now living on the NAS.

posts.title: Taking the Email Off the Page, and Knowing When to Undo a Logo
posts.excerpt: Pulled my real email out of the contact form and routed it through a masked endpoint, added tag filtering to the blog so posts can be browsed by topic, then spent the evening building a custom logo to replace the placeholder diamond — tried it in the nav and footer, decided it wasn't right, and reverted it. Finished by pushing the day's work live.

posts.title: The Copy Goes Live, and the Lab Page Turns Personal
posts.excerpt: Shipped the copy and card rework that had been sitting on the local server, matched the portfolio subpages to it, then pulled the Lab out of the public site and rebuilt it as a personal launcher that only links the services already safe to be public. Finished by catching the blog up and writing a small script to generate posts from journals.

posts.title: Sharper Words, Smaller Cards: A Copy Pass on the Portfolio
posts.excerpt: Went back to the portfolio that shipped yesterday and fixed the part I'd skimmed: the writing. Stripped the filler out of the copy, rewrote it to talk to an employer, shrank the project cards down to a title and a Details button, and made the dead buttons actually work — all kept local for review, nothing pushed yet.

posts.title: Three Designs, a Domain Cutover, and the Media Stack Comes Home
posts.excerpt: The portfolio redesign shipped to n5hq.me after three full rebuilds — then the bigger job: pulling the whole media automation stack off the rented seedbox and onto the home server, with the 22TB of storage staying put and the file moves still happening at the source.

posts.title: Storage Fixes, Vault Cleanup, and the Reboot That Bit Back
posts.excerpt: Renamed the external drive mount, set up Samba shares, fixed the T7 Shield's UAS instability — then the reboot that fix required quietly took down Home Assistant and the website dev server. Recovery story included.

posts.title: Network Fixes, Tailscale, and a NIC Upgrade
posts.excerpt: Diagnosed the Aqara doorbell and Canon printer issues via UniFi MCP, got Tailscale running across all devices, installed Claude CLI on the MacBook, and swapped the server NIC to 2.5GbE.

posts.title: Automating the Blog & Cleaning Up the Portfolio
posts.excerpt: Wired up GitHub Actions to auto-publish blog posts, stripped placeholder content, and cleaned up the portfolio tiles to show only what's real.

posts.title: Building Momentum: Homelab Services + Website Launch
posts.excerpt: Deployed the monitoring stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki), made Immich publicly accessible, and completed the N5HQ website with portfolio and contact sections.

posts.title: Home Assistant Goes Public
posts.excerpt: Got Home Assistant accessible remotely via Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnel — after about 1.5 hours of chasing a silent 502.
